data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
data.text:
Get to Know the Team

The team is a dynamic and diverse backend team, responsible for maintaining and enhancing systems within Grab's Content Engines. This includes developing features for the Catalog and User-Generated Content (UGC) platforms, which are important to the delivery services in the Grab superapp

Get to Know the Role

By joining the team you will get a chance to work with the best engineers in the region. You will be reporting to Software Engineering Manager II. You will create a high impact when your work reaches millions of customers. You will get a chance to work on scalable services which can process tens of millions of orders daily. Each service is carefully designed keeping in mind all the possible failures and fallback solutions to ensure we are always running to serve our customers.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

- You will work with the product and design team to understand requirements, provide product feedback, own and implement the product from start to finish.
- You will create and participate in technical discussions with other engineering teams.
- You will write code that is reusable, scalable and testable. Make sure products are delivered on time and with high quality.
- You will collaborate with QAs to make sure all product requirements are met and the deployments are stable.
- You will review code from other team members, provide constructive feedback and aim to raise the engineering bar.

What We Stand For At Grab

Mô tả công việc

+ Thiết kế, phát triển và duy trì các hệ thống ứng dụng web và dịch vụ backend sử dụng Java và Spring Boot phục vụ cho các giao dịch chứng khoán, quản lý tài khoản và các công cụ hỗ trợ khác.
+ Lập trình các chức năng liên quan đến giao dịch, xử lý dữ liệu tài chính, báo cáo và các dịch vụ khác trong môi trường chứng khoán.
+ Đảm bảo các ứng dụng hoạt động ổn định, hiệu suất cao và bảo mật.

+ Thực hiện các nghiệp vụ quản lý giao dịch chứng khoán và dữ liệu tài khoản, đảm bảo tính nhất quán và an toàn của dữ liệu.

- Tối ưu hóa hiệu suất và bảo mật:

data.title: Senior Backend Developer (MPC Crypto Wallet Project)
data.text:
Position Overview
Regen Tech is building the next generation of secure, privacy-preserving digital wallets using Multi-Party Computation (MPC). We are seeking a Senior Backend Developer to help architect, scale, and secure the core infrastructure of our platform. This role sits at the intersection of cloud engineering, cryptographic coordination, and cross-platform system design, working closely with experts across mobile, firmware, and cryptography teams.

You will lead and contribute to the development of services that orchestrate secure operations between cloud systems, mobile clients, and hardware devices, ensuring high performance, auditability, and fault tolerance.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the design, implementation, and deployment of scalable cloud-based backend services to support MPC-driven wallet functionality.
- Coordinate architectural decisions between cloud, mobile, and hardware teams, ensuring seamless integration of cryptographic protocols.
- Define and implement secure authentication, transaction workflows, key orchestration logic, and encrypted communication flows.
- Manage system observability, cloud performance, CI/CD pipelines, and security posture across environments.
- Participate in or lead engagements with internal and external security auditors.
- Mentor junior engineers and potentially build/manage a backend/cloud team.

data.title: Senior Backend Developer (MPC Crypto Wallet Project)
data.text: - Guide long-term cloud infrastructure strategy, especially around Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes-based environments.

data.title: Senior Backend Developer (MPC Crypto Wallet Project)
data.text:
Must-have:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of professional experience in backend development, with a focus on distributed systems, cloud orchestration, and service reliability.
- Proficiency in Go, Node.js, TypeScript, or other modern backend languages.
- Experience designing and building REST/gRPC APIs, microservices, and asynchronous workflows.
- Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure (GCP, AWS, or Azure), with strong knowledge of containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).
- Experience working with SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB).
- Strong security mindset, with experience building secure-by-default systems and supporting user privacy.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across multi-disciplinary teams.

Nice-to-have:
- Direct experience with cryptographic systems, MPC protocols, or key management infrastructure.
- Familiarity with blockchain protocols, smart contracts, or crypto wallet systems.
- Hands-on experience with GCP and services like Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage.
- GCP Certifications (e.g., Cloud Architect, DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
- Experience working with mobile or embedded hardware is a strong bonus.

data.title: Senior Front-End Developer
data.text:
Senior Frontend Engineer

Reports To: The Senior Frontend Engineer will report to the Solution Architecture Leader

Job Overview: Be part of a fast-growing team of developers to support a range of frontend tasks to build several C2C products.

Responsibilities and Duties:
- Participate in all software development activities following the Scrum process.
- Gather and address technical and design requirements.
- Develop highly responsive, web-based user interface components and modules using ReactJS, NextJS.
- Design and implement responsive, efficient, and attractive user interfaces.
- Work closely with UX/UI teams to ensure the final product meets design and user experience standards.
- Optimize application performance for speed and scalability.
- Contribute to technology assessment, selection, and technical decision-making.
- Collaborate with backend teams for API and service integration.
- Maintain and improve code quality, ensuring high maintainability and quality.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers within the team.
- Review AI-generated code (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT) to ensure quality and maintainability.
- Investigate root causes of bugs and provide constructive feedback and coaching.
- Contribute to technical decision-making processes within the team.
- Promote knowledge sharing and maintain well-organized documentation across the team.

Candidate Must Have:

data.title: Senior Front-End Developer
data.text:
- High energy and a desire to work in a results-oriented, fast growth company that never lost its start-up spirit.

- Experience with AngularJS.
- Have AI Coding knowledge:
- Have hands-on experience using AI-powered coding assistants (Cursor, Copilot, Devin, or similar tools) in real-world projects.
- Understand how to collaborate with AI agents to speed up prototyping, refactor legacy code, generate boilerplate code, and automate repetitive tasks.

data.title: Senior Front-End Developer

Employment Hero is on a mission to make employment easier and more valuable for everyone. Our Employment Operating System brings hiring, HR, payroll and benefits into an all-in-one solution.

Since our inception in 2014, we've scaled to a $2 billion valuation and gained a presence in 6 countries globally - Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, the UK and Canada. We now service over 300,000 businesses and more than 2 million employees.

The EH Way

At Employment Hero, we're proud of our unique DNA, which we call The EH Way.

We are Mission First - everything we do (from what we work on, to how we allocate capital and where we focus) is driven by our Mission
We are Remote First - we champion a remote environment with a preference for asynchronous communication and a high degree of autonomy
We are AI First - we are committed to using AI to accelerate our mission; AI is not just a tool, it's a fundamental part of how we operate, innovate, and scale
We are Apolitical - we do not take a position on political or social topics, unless it relates to our Mission
We Live by Our Values - we role model our values 100% of the time
We Expect High Performance - we set a high standard and we're not satisfied with being average

About The Role

Our Partnerships and Payroll team are growing. We're looking for an amazing Intermediate Software Development Engineer (.Net) to join us as we scale our products and features and take on interesting technical challenges.

data.title: Intermediate/Senior Data Engineer
data.text:
1. Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to collect, clean, and process large-scale datasets in data systems.
2. Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and develop Data Lake and Data Warehouse solutions for analytics, reporting, and AI/ML. Utilize BI tools like Grafana, AWS QuickSight, and Google Sheets for data visualization.
3. Build and optimize data architecture, including Lakehouse (AWS S3, Delta Lake), Data Warehouse (Redshift), and technologies like Kafka for both streaming and batch data processing.
4. Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline issues to ensure data integrity and timely delivery. Utilize tools such as Sentry, Grafana, Prometheus, and AWS CloudWatch to track logs and send alerts via Slack.
5. Document technical processes, maintain data catalogs, and ensure compliance with data governance policies. Use the Atlassian toolset (Jira, Confluence) or Slack for work management and team collaboration.
6. Optimize the performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of data systems. Enhance the scalability and efficiency of all components, including Kafka, dbt, Airflow, Airbyte, and storage solutions like PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Redis, and AWS S3, as well as data processing and orchestration frameworks.
7. Continuously research and implement new technologies to optimize the current system, applying best practices in Data Engineering and DataOps.

data.title: Freelance Software Developer (Python-Rust) - AI Trainer
data.text:
At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as an AI Tutor in Coding, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

- Analyze and understand existing code in Python or C/C++
- Migrate logic to idiomatic, safe Rust while preserving functionality
- Adapt or port the test suite and ensure behavioral equivalence
- Document migration steps and technical decisions

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

- You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or other related fields.
- You have at least 3 years of professional experience with Python and 1+ year of hands-on experience with Rust

Với lợi thế đặc biệt về hạ tầng dữ liệu lớn, VinBigdata cung cấp các sản phẩm, giải pháp tiên ứng dụng trí tuệ nhân tạo, giúp doanh nghiệp đẩy nhanh quá trình chuyển đổi số, tối ưu hiệu quả vận hành, kinh doanh và gia tăng trải nghiệm người dùng cuối.

Là một công ty trẻ trung và đang trong giai đoạn phát triển nhanh chóng, VinBigdata luôn chào đón những tài năng gia nhập công ty để cùng thực hiện mục tiêu “Công nghệ Việt – Vì tương lai Việt”.

Chúng tôi đề cao và tìm kiếm các nhân sự có tinh thần sáng tạo, đam mê tạo ra những sản phẩm và dịch vụ mới giúp người Việt Nam có cuộc sống tiện lợi, văn minh và lành mạnh hơn, sẵn sàng thử thách bản thân, học hỏi và chịu được áp lực lớn trong công việc.

Nhóm kỹ sư kiểm thử chất lượng của trợ lý ảo thông minh đảm nhiệm việc đảm bảo chất lượng trọng quá trình phát triển và triển khai các sản phẩm như hệ sinh thái trí tuệ nhân tạo đa nhận thức toàn diện Vinbase, trợ lý ảo Vivi ứng dụng linh hoạt trong hệ sinh thái thông minh trên xe ô tô, loa, nhà thông minh.

data.title: Cộng tác viên Kiểm thử chất lượng/Tester
data.text:
- Chuẩn bị, cập nhật và duy trì tài liệu kiểm thử liên quan, bao gồm các kịch bản, sơ đồ, mẫu kiểm thử, đảm bảo tuân thủ quy trình thử nghiệm và tiêu chuẩn chất lượng. Thực hiện đánh giá phần mềm, hoàn thiện kịch bản kiểm thử và ghi lại bằng chứng kiểm thử để đảm bảo phần mềm đáp ứng thông số kỹ thuật.
- Nghiên cứu & tìm hiểu yêu cầu nghiệp vụ, yêu cầu hệ thống từ BA hoặc các bên liên quan. Dựa vào kinh nghiệm và hiểu biết, góp ý & hỗ trợ BA hoàn thiện yêu cầu chi tiết. Thiết kế luồng hội thoại tương tác giữa khách hàng và bot trong nhiều ngữ cảnh khác nhau.
- Thực hiện kiểm thử tự động để kiểm tra hệ thống và phần mềm, đồng thời ghi lại kết quả kiểm tra trong các báo cáo và tài liệu liên quan.
- Phối hợp với các thành viên khác để thực hiện các công việc liên quan đến kiểm thử.

III. TRÁCH NHIỆM
- Nghiên cứu tài liệu về nghiệp vụ và kỹ thuật của hệ thống để tìm ra và đánh giá các ràng buộc của sản phẩm, bao gồm các sản phẩm: Hệ thống quản lý, Giải thuật AI, Backend, Frontend, ứng dụng mobile.
- Lên kế hoạch và phương án kiểm thử theo quy trình Agile Scrum.
- Chuẩn bị và cập nhật các tài liệu liên quan đến kiểm thử bao gồm: kế hoạch, kịch bản, sơ đồ mô tả, dữ liệu và các báo cáo kiểm thử theo tiêu chuẩn chất lượng.
- Thực hiện kiểm thử, phối hợp với các thành viên khác để đánh giá chất lượng phần mềm.

data.text: About Us In 2004, (called MyRecipes back then) rocked the food service industry with an app which enabled users to do things they previously could only dream of. We gave New Zealand's professional chefs the power to cost any recipe in just minutes, as well as know the nutrition - something which was prone to error, was difficult, and used to take a long time. While we made headlines, and were in fact SAAS pioneers, we didn't think much of this. For us, it was just the beginning of a mission which had only just begun. Fast forward 20 years, (gee! where did that go?!) with the support of our users who love our app, we're on a new mission to take this to the world using cutting edge tech to do things even smarter, easier and faster. We’re looking for a strong python backend end developer with some experience in machine learning and excellent communication skills to collaborate closely with our team, ensuring solutions are well-aligned with real-world needs. You should bring sharp analytical and problem-solving abilities, along with experience working in agile teams and a solid understanding of agile principles. Your ability to navigate technical challenges and contribute to a collaborative, fast-paced environment will be key to your success in this role. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or related fields Responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems and APIs Develop robust infrastructure to support data processing and integration of ML models Implement and manage deployment pipelines for backend services and machine learning workflows Build automated testing frameworks for backend components and ML pipelines Ensure system performance, reliability, and scalability in production environments Monitor and debug backend and ML systems to ensure high availability and security Collaborate with frontend, DevOps, and data teams to deliver integrated, production-ready solutions Optimize backend workflows and ML pipelines for efficiency, maintainability, and continuous delivery Your skills and experience Must have: 3+ years python experience 1+ years machine learning experience. Experience with libraries like Scikit-Learn Experience with backend API’s Experience with relational or non-relational databases. Eg Mongo and Postgres Experience with FastAPI or similar Might have: General knowledge in python libraries related to scraping, data processing. Experience with Dev-ops (CI/CD) Experience with pipelines Basic English communication skills Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Why you'll love working here Our current team of 11 are based in Vietnam and the Philippines and are all incredibly passionate about what we do. We're very excited about what we are building and cant wait to release our new version. We follow agile methodology and love working together as a team. Our team values and team culture revolve around: Simplification over complication. Removing and decrypting jargon. Efficiency and smart thinking over hard work. Work-life balance. We all value local working hours and respect time away from work. We celebrate the wins. And often. Teamwork. Collaboration fuels our success. We all win together. Innovation. We seek new ways to solve problems. Delight. Usability is good, but delight is better. We aim to surprise and exceed expectations. Communication. Above all else, clear communication keeps us aligned.

data.title: Software Engineer – Theia IDE Development For RISC-V
data.text:
Mô tả công việc:
- Develop and maintain core features of the Theia-based IDE, ensuring a seamless and productive developer experience.
- Integrate and optimize RISC-V and ARM toolchains (GCC/LLVM) within the IDE, enabling efficient compilation and debugging workflows.
- Implement and enhance debugging capabilities for RISC-V and ARM using GDB/LLDB, providing advanced features such as real-time system monitoring and multi-core debugging.
- Design and develop Theia extensions and plugins to support specialized embedded development needs, including tracing, profiling, and hardware-specific interactions.
- Enable seamless debugging of embedded targets deployed on the cloud, leveraging Theia's extensibility to integrate with cloud platforms.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and ensure the IDE meets the evolving needs of embedded developers.
- Contribute to the development and maintenance of a comprehensive suite of documentation and tutorials to support users.

Yêu cầu ứng viên:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and experience with web-based development.
- Familiarity with Theia framework or other web-based IDEs is a plus.
- Knowledge of embedded systems and development (RISC-V or ARM) is a plus.
- Familiarity with C/C++ and debugging tools (GDB/LLDB) is a plus.
- Eagerness to learn and a proactive attitude.

data.title: QA Tester
data.text:
Collaborate within a multidisciplinary team to develop engineering documentation that ensures compliance with QMS, ISO 9001:2015, and quality control standards, while verifying alignment with customer manufacturing requirements.

Key Tasks:
• Develop and implement plans to achieve company quality objectives, while monitoring progress and results.
• Oversee the Quality Management System (QMS).
• Ensure daily adherence to QMS procedures, assisting staff as needed.
• Draft and maintain procedures and work instructions.
• Collect performance data and generate monthly reports.
• Continuously analyze operations to identify areas for improvement.
• Manage and promote the effective use of the Internal Reporting (IR) system.
• Develop and execute product design verification and testing plans.
• Transfer validated final product designs to project leaders for customer release.
• Report on the overall state of the QMS to management, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.
• Perform additional related tasks as required.

data.title: QA Tester
data.text:
Education
• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related field.
• Additional coursework in electronic design, embedded systems, industrial design, and project management is preferred.

Experience
• Minimum of two years of quality assurance experience, specifically applying ISO 9001 standards within engineering, product development, or manufacturing.
• At least one year of experience in test engineering, specializing in electronics, software, or mechanical systems.

Technical Knowledge
• General knowledge of manufacturing techniques and principles for electronic, software, and mechanical products.
• Solid understanding of QA laboratory testing, including test planning, test case development, and execution for mechatronic products (mechanical, electronic, firmware/software).
• Experience with QA test environments, including Jira, SVN, TestRail, or custom tracking tools like Excel.
• Knowledge of customer service principles, including needs assessment techniques, quality standards, alternative delivery systems, and customer satisfaction evaluations.
• Understanding product design verification testing methodologies for mechatronic systems.
• Expertise in test analysis, test reporting, deviation handling, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and Six Sigma (preferred).
• Familiarity with industrial standards, including EtherCAT, Ethernet Conformance Test, PROFINET Conformance Test, and DeviceNet Conformance Test.

data.title: QA Tester
data.text:
• Capabilities in Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) and Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) testing at third-party labs (such as Quatest) and certification processes for CE compliance.
• Experience with Python, LabVIEW, DAQ, and PLC programming is a plus.
• Implementation of ISO 9001:2015 QMS requirements.

Skills
• Strong project management, analytical, and communication skills.
• Independent, objective, detail-oriented, and proactive approach to work.
• Ability to systematically organize and document QMS performance, assessments, and continuous improvements.
• Capability to summarize and report QMS findings to management, along with improvement recommendations.
• Skill in identifying nonconformities in QMS and product designs, collaborating with teams to issue and execute improvement reports.
• Ability to plan, conduct, and document validation testing of product designs.
• Effective team player with solid communication skills.
• Intermediate English.

data.text:
Mô tả công việc

Yêu cầu ứng viên

- Có kinh nghiệm lập trình giao tiếp với các thiết bị đo lường qua các giao thức như RS232/485, LAN, USB, GPIB, CAN, Modbus, v.v.
- Thành thạo một trong các ngôn ngữ lập trình: Python, C#, C++, LabVIEW, hoặc tương đương. Có hiểu biết về thiết kế mạch điện, hệ thống điều khiển, cảm biến, actuator, và các hệ thống đo lường.
- Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm thực tế trong việc xây dựng jig test, hệ thống kiểm tra tự động, hoặc từng làm việc trong môi trường sản xuất công nghiệp.
- Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề, tư duy logic và khả năng làm việc độc lập/tập thể tốt.

data.title: Tuyển Nhân Viên ML Engineer
data.text:
Mô tả công việc

PSA là công ty eCommerce hoạt động trong các lĩnh vực Print-on-Demand, Dropshipping, Fulfillment và Bán lẻ online, phục vụ hơn 10,000+ khách hàng toàn cầu.

Chúng tôi đang phát triển các hệ thống nội bộ (ERP, OMS, CRM, Data Analytics...) nhằm tối ưu hóa quy trình vận hành và nâng cao trải nghiệm người dùng, hướng tới mô hình AI-driven eCommerce.

Mô Tả Công Việc

Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm Machine Learning Engineer để thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp AI/ML ứng dụng trong hệ thống vận hành thương mại điện tử quy mô lớn.

Bạn sẽ làm việc cùng team Product, Data và Dev để:

- Thiết kế, huấn luyện, và triển khai các mô hình ML cho:
- Dự đoán nhu cầu đơn hàng,
- Tối ưu tồn kho/kho vận,
- Recommendation hệ sản phẩm,
- Phân khúc khách hàng,
- Chatbot hỗ trợ CSKH.

- Xây dựng pipeline xử lý dữ liệu (ETL) và hệ thống MLops cơ bản;
- Đánh giá hiệu suất mô hình và triển khai lên production;
- Tối ưu hóa chi phí và tài nguyên tính toán (GPU/Cloud).

Yêu cầu công việc

Bắt Buộc

- Có từ 2-3 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc với ML (classification, regression, clustering...);
- Thành thạo Python, NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow hoặc PyTorch;
- Có kinh nghiệm xử lý dữ liệu lớn, làm việc với data pipeline (Airflow, Spark, BigQuery là lợi thế);
- Hiểu về triển khai mô hình trên môi trường thực tế (Docker, REST API, FastAPI, Flask);
- Kỹ năng đọc hiểu tốt tài liệu tiếng Anh.

Ưu Tiên

- Đã từng triển khai recommendation system, hoặc hệ thống AI trong eCommerce / Retail;

data.text:
Junior Front-end Developer (ReactJS)

Hybrid Working

"For millions of Vietnamese people never have to queue to buy ticket…again" – Van Tran – CEO

Vexere is a technology company aiming to revolutionize the travel and transportation industry in Vietnam. We are pioneering in comprehensive digital transformation of the transport industry with diverse web applications and latest technology apps. We are available on all super apps such as Grab, Momo, Zalopay… We have all types of tickets from low-priced to luxury cars. Today Vexere is the largest online inter-city bus ticketing platform that empowers millions of travelers to make their life journeys happier.

Join us to be part of a warrior team to conquer any difficulty, to strive for the best user experience. You will be part of the team to build all components in Vexere design language system and put to storybook where other teams can come and use your components at easy. Part of frontend team, you will build fast and sleek websites in ReactJS, applying the most modern philosophy such as Progressive Web App, Universal Web App to provide web content to user at blazing speed while still stick to SEO best practices. Constantly use Lighthouse and many other tools to monitor web performance and bundle sizes to optimize to the best.

We are proud to provide to you many challenging works while solving society problems, to make your life and your family’s life much better.

Fullstack developer is a plus.

data.text:
We are looking for Software Engineers to join our cutting-edge Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) project. If you are passionate about AGI, have a strong background in Python (Go, Java,...) and excel at problem-solving, critical thinking, and self-learning, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Responsibilities

- Collaborate with engineering teams to design, develop, and deploy business critical solutions.
- Stay continuously informed about the latest advancements and trends in the AGI field.
- Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code to implement new features and functionalities.
- Research and adopt new techniques and methodologies to solve complex problems, utilizing critical thinking and analytical skills.

- Share knowledge through peer-to-peer collaboration, conduct code reviews, provide technical guidance, and mentor junior team members as needed.

About Us

We are an AI Fintech company specializing in assessing credit profiles of consumers in emerging markets combining pioneering AI with large alternative data sources. In 2020 we reached our ambitious milestone of credit profiling 1 billion consumers spanning 4 countries - Vietnam, Indonesia, India & the Philippines - and building a platform for the wider industry and the financial services industry, in particular, to provide the "un & under" served access to credit. At the core of this initiative has been our strict and unwavering adherence to the norms of consumer data privacy and consumer data rights.

But we're not satisfied as we embark on the next leg of our journey to deliver 100 million credit lines to consumers in the markets where we operate. Although this goal is ambitious, we truly believe that by harnessing the power of AI & Big Data we can deliver financial access at an unprecedented scale.

As a firm, we're audacious problem-solvers motivated by our impact on society. We deeply espouse the values of ownership - of our actions and initiatives, integrity in all we do, and agility in execution.

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.text:
1. Tốt nghiệp hệ chính quy các Trường Đại học các chuyên ngành đào tạo: Công nghệ thông tin, Toán tin, Điện tử Viễn thông...

- Thời gian thực tập tối thiểu 5 buổi/tuần.
- Có máy tính cá nhân.
- Chủ động, ham học hỏi, chăm chỉ, tư duy tốt.

Nice to have

- Ưu tiên ứng viên có dự án cá nhân.
- Có hiểu biết về các mô hình MVC, MVVM
- Ưu tiên ứng viên đã từng làm việc với các ngôn ngữ lập trình như: NodeJS, PHP, ReactJS.
- Ưu tiên ứng viên đã từng làm việc với các database như MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB

-Được training on job, tham gia trực tiếp vào các dự án thực tế của công ty ngay trong thời gian đào tạo.
-Được hỗ trợ thủ tục dấu đỏ, giấy xác nhận thực tập.
-Được đào tạo kỹ năng lập trình web, mobile để lựa chọn ngôn ngữ lập trình phù hợp.
-Thử sức với các dự án hấp dẫn trong và ngoài nước.
-Được làm việc trong môi trường cởi mở, năng động.
-Cơ hội trở thành nhân viên chính thức sau khi hoàn thành khóa đào tạo.
-Lộ trình: thực tập (tối thiểu 3 tháng) -> Thử việc (2 tháng) -> Nhân viên chính thức.

-Mức lương khởi điểm hấp dẫn, tương xứng với năng lực làm việc.

data.text:

-Khám sức khỏe định kỳ 1 năm/1 lần.
-Nghỉ thứ 7, chủ nhật + 12 ngày phép/năm.
-Thời gian làm việc từ đủ 3 năm sẽ được cộng thêm 1 ngày phép vào các năm tiếp theo.

-Team building hàng tháng, du lịch hàng năm, sinh nhật hàng tháng cho nhân viên.
-Môi trường làm việc thoải mái theo phong cách Âu Mỹ (Western Style) với chế độ môi trường vui vẻ, thoải mái;

At Timebeat, we are at the cutting edge of precision time synchronisation technology, delivering world-class solutions in hardware, software, advisory services, and cloud hosting. data.title: VN Technology Full-stack Engineer (Platform)
data.text:
Recruitment Background & Expected Role

CADDi is on a mission to "Unleash the potential of manufacturing."

We operate "CADDi DRAWER," a cloud-based system that supports digital transformation centered on the use of drawings, which are the most essential data in the manufacturing industry.

One of the issues we are currently facing in the development of this rapidly growing product is developer productivity. The inefficiencies in the development environment have become more noticeable, and they are becoming a hindrance to the development of features and a degradation of the developer experience. As an activity to resolve these issues, the need for Platform Engineering is increasing.

There are various interpretations and approaches to Platform Engineering in the world, but here, we will be working on providing tools and infrastructure to increase the development velocity by "separating concerns."

Examples of anticipated tasks (not limited to)

Among these, in this post, you will be working on the following tasks

- Communication and collaboration with developers to increase the value provided
- Development and operation of self-service tools and platforms
- Improvement of development processes and environments, not limited to the provision of new tools
- Besides the team we are recruiting for this time, you may be assigned to other teams depending on your experience and preferences. (In that case, we would be happy to discuss this with you at the interview.)

data.text:

Interest And Experience Gained From This Position

- The fun of integrating a complex domain into a system
- Experience in solving difficult problems with highly motivated team members
- Experience in contributing to the scale of a product with technical skills
- Experience in developing products that are deployed globally
- Experience in providing value to society through the development of products that change

Organization

- The Platform Department supports engineers in all aspects of product feature development, providing QA, SRE and security expertise across teams, as well as cross-system infrastructure and processing infrastructure
- The Platform Engineering Team is a newly established team. With the mission of "Unleash the Potential of Developers," we aim to free developers from time-consuming development errands and cognitive load so that they can focus on delivering value

REQUIREMENTS

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

- 7+ years of hands-on experience developing for web applications
- Experience in decision-making regarding technology selection, architecture design, and construction for the entire service
- Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD). Experience in improving code and system quality through various mechanisms, such as automated execution of Linter, Code Analyzer, API tests, and End-to-End (E2E) tests

Tìm kiếm, đánh giá và làm việc với các nhà cung cấp nguyên phụ liệu. Đàm phán giá cả, thời gian giao hàng và các điều khoản hợp tác. Đảm bảo nguyên phụ liệu tuân thủ các quy định về môi trường và pháp luật.

Làm việc với các bộ phận R&D, Sản xuất, Thu mua và Thiết kế để lựa chọn nguyên phụ liệu phù hợp. Trao đổi với khách hàng, đối tác về tiêu chuẩn nguyên phụ liệu và phê duyệt sản phẩm.

- Có kinh nghiệm phân tích hiệu năng hệ thống, xử lý đa luồng, tối ưu độ trễ thấp (low-latency) và quản lý dữ liệu thời gian thực.

data.text:
About Us

Kegmil is revolutionizing the way mission-critical facilities and assets are repaired and maintained via complex systems of people and processes. We are on a mission to empower millions of deskless field service professionals in Southeast Asia with technology and data to supercharge their operational efficiency and service performance. Our cloud-based, mobile-first software intelligently automates and optimizes field activities for maintenance heroes who keep our world running across industries from elevator to data center equipment servicing.

We are a curious and collaborative team that derives purpose and joy from putting our customers at the center of our innovation, helping them to transform and grow their businesses profitably. Our culture also inspires our employees to be their best in an inclusive and supportive environment. We listen to and learn from one another, take ownership and deliver on our promises with grit, resilience and speed to lead the age-old field service industry into the future.

Role

Kegmil is in search of a QC Engineer with 2-3 years of experience, adept at both manual and automated testing, and possessing a positive attitude with a willingness to learn. As a valued member of the product-core development team, your role will involve contributing your insights and efforts to ensure the successful launch of our product, meeting and exceeding clients' expectations.

Responsibilities

data.title: QC Engineer
data.text:
• Review requirements, specifications, and technical design documents to provide timely and insightful feedback.
• Create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test cases.
• Estimate and prioritize testing activities effectively.
• Identify, record, meticulously document, and track bugs.
• Conduct thorough regression testing once bugs are resolved.
• Collaborate with internal teams, including developers and product managers, to identify system requirements and address issues.
• Design, develop, and execute automation scripts using open-source tools (experience in this area is a plus).

Requirements
• Demonstrated work experience in software quality assurance (minimum of 2-3 years).
• Profound knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
• Proven ability to craft clear, concise, and comprehensive test cases.
• Experience with Test Management and Bug Tracking tools.
• Hands-on experience with both white box and black box testing.
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development processes.
• Ability to work independently or collaboratively with other QC team members.
• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
• Proficiency in using automated testing tools (experience in this area is a plus).
• Exposure to performance and/or security testing (experience in these areas is a plus).
• Able to work independently and ability to control quality in a development group.
• Product mindset.

Why join us

data.title: QC Engineer
data.text:
• Collaborate with seasoned and highly skilled technical experts, including software architects with over a decade of experience.
• Engage with cutting-edge technologies such as Microservices, Service Mesh, Big Data, AI/Machine Learning, and IoT.
• Enjoy an attractive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
• Benefit from a flexible work schedule tailored to your needs.
• Experience a friendly and dynamic workplace environment.
• Access annual health check-ups and premium healthcare coverage.
• Receive annual salary reviews based on your demonstrated abilities and contributions.
• Participate in company outings, a year-end celebration, team-building activities, and more.

data.title: Senior Product Designer (AI/UX, Enterprise SaaS)
data.text:
About Us
Reforged Labs is a YC-backed, Sandhill Road funded AI startup revolutionizing how the world's top mobile gaming studios market themselves to hundreds of millions of players. We're building cutting-edge AI technology that powers sophisticated ad analysis and generation pipelines for elite global gaming companies.
We don't follow trend; we set them. Our engineering team builds solutions that rival the best Silicon Valley has to offer, creating technology that generates millions of dollars in value for our customers.

The Role
We're seeking an exceptional Senior Product Designer to join our fast-growing team in Ho Chi Minh City. This is not a role for the average designer; we're looking exclusively for extraordinary talent who can compete with the best designers globally.

You'll spearhead the user experience design of our AI-driven platforms, crafting intuitive interfaces that make powerful technology accessible and delightful to use. Your designs will directly impact how hundreds of millions of players discover and experience games through our AI-powered marketing tools.

Core Responsibilities
● Design elegant, intuitive interfaces for our AI copilot tools that seamlessly blend sophistication with usability
● Create comprehensive user journeys and information architecture for complex AI-powered workflows
● Develop and maintain a cohesive design system that ensures consistency across our product suite

data.title: Senior Product Designer (AI/UX, Enterprise SaaS)
data.text:
● Translate product requirements into thoughtful user experiences that make AI capabilities accessible
● Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to bridge user needs with technical possibilities
● Gather and incorporate user feedback through thoughtful iteration cycles
● Drive design decisions that shape our platform's user experience and future direction
● Set the standard for design excellence and best practices across the organization

data.title: Senior Product Designer (AI/UX, Enterprise SaaS)
data.text:
Required Experience
● 5+ years of product design experience with a focus on complex digital products
● Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional design work that has reached millions of users
● Experience designing interfaces for AI-powered products or features
● Expert knowledge of design tools (Figma, Sketch, etc.) and prototyping techniques
● Track record of designing B2B SaaS applications and consumer-facing products
● Deep understanding of how humans interact with AI systems and how to design for these interactions
● Experience with user research, testing methodologies, and data-informed design decisions ● Professional English communication skills (verbal and written)

Essential Qualities
● Creative problem-solver who can make complex technologies accessible through intuitive design
● Strategic thinker who considers both short-term usability and long-term product vision
● Self-starter mentality with strong ownership of the design process from concept to implementation
● Excellence in time management and ability to meet ambitious deadlines
● Clear communication skills, especially around design decisions and trade-offs
● Collaborative mindset with the ability to incorporate feedback while maintaining design integrity
● Passion for creating exceptional user experiences that drive product adoption and engagement
● Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment

Interview Process
1. Initial Portfolio Review & Discussion (60 mins)

data.title: Senior Product Designer (AI/UX, Enterprise SaaS)
data.text:
○ Portfolio presentation and walkthrough
○ Design thinking and problem-solving discussion
○ High-level experience overview
2. Design Challenge (1 week to complete)
○ Real-world problem related to our domain
○ Opportunity to demonstrate your skills comprehensively
3. Design Review & Collaboration Exercise (90 mins) ○ Deep dive into your design challenge solution
○ Collaborative design exercise with our team
○ Discussion on design systems and scalability

○ Vision alignment with founders
○ Culture and team fit discussion

We aim to complete the entire process within 2-3 weeks.

We're looking for candidates who can demonstrate outstanding design abilities and deliver outsized impact.

If you believe you're among the most skilled product designers and are excited about shaping cutting-edge AI interfaces, we want to talk to you.

We are an AI Fintech company specializing in assessing credit profiles of consumers in emerging markets combining pioneering AI with large alternative data sources. In 2020 we reached our ambitious milestone of credit profiling 1 billion consumers spanning 4 countries - Vietnam, Indonesia, India & the Philippines - and building a platform for the wider industry and the financial services industry, in particular, to provide the "un & underserved" access to credit. But we're not satisfied as we embark on the next leg of our journey to deliver 100 million credit lines to consumers in the markets where we operate. Although this goal is ambitious, we truly believe that by harnessing the power of AI & Big Data we can deliver financial access at an unprecedented scale.

As a firm, we're audacious problem-solvers motivated by our impact on society. We deeply espouse the values of ownership - of our actions and initiatives, integrity in all we do, and agility in execution.

data.title: ERP Support (Fresher Business Analyst)
data.text:
Let’s become our Application Support, and you will participate in various technology projects at 7-Eleven Vietnam; collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to gather requirements and feedback, and help address those needs effectively; conduct internal training sessions on 7-Eleven services for relevant departments; as an Application Support member, you are responsible for ensuring the delivery of 7-Eleven services to end-users with a focus on satisfaction. You will also support Product Managers in implementing assigned projects and contribute ideas to enhance 7-Eleven services where possible.

We expect you to duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: to create preliminary study documents in terms of business functional area; to create Gap analysis between new or change request and current system; to follow up IT implementation in order to make in line with Business Requirement; manage and maintain all parameters of the applications; frequently review and assess functionalities of in–used application to ensure the solution meets the business process and user ‘s needs; raise changes to development team and involved users if required; support end-users for any functional incidents.

data.text: Having these technical requirements will be your advance 0-1 year Knowledge, Skills and Abilities in Business Analyst / Application Support / Customer Support. Understood analyst and design system, get and sum up requirements, good communication skills. A fast learner, ability to multi-task and work independently under high pressure. Problem solving. Experience in Retail Tech.

data.title: ERP Support (Fresher Business Analyst)
data.text: You will love working here because we are cool, optimizing for scale, handling millions records of data; building real-time retails system at scale with Kafka; developing the Retail Management System helps 7-Eleven Vietnam to save cost and earn money such as Ecommerce Website, Payment Gateway, Loyalty Application, Supply Chain System, Warehouse Management System, POS, HHT. Refer on to get more details; modern tech stack (Google Cloud Platform, Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher) and tools (Google Chat, Jira); catching up with new technologies through the process: experiment, trial, adopt; in partnership with Grab, Google, ZaloPay, MoMo, Shopee, TAPTAP, Utop QR, VNPAY, Got It, Urbox for tech & digital integrations; agile at heart, everything is flexible and possible; flat team, nice colleagues, no boss; strong engineering culture, read more of our stories on . And some benefits: the flexible working environment in terms of time, office; (Mon - Fri; 9AM - 5PM); social insurance and comprehensive health care insurance included; support 50% to buy a new MacBook after passing probation (in case you do not use laptop provided by company); 13th month-salary; chances for training and development (learning outdoor/indoor, training course, soft skills); having allowances for meals, mobile phone, birthday, special days; company trip, and many team activities (movies, games, lunch); nice office at the center of Phu My Hung District 7.

data.text:
At LeapXpert, we're revolutionizing business communication by seamlessly integrating the familiarity of consumer messaging apps with enterprise-grade security and compliance.

As pioneers in responsible business communications, we empower employees and clients to connect through their preferred messaging platforms while upholding the highest standards of governance and security.

Our mission is to transform workplace communication globally.

We've been recognized as a Visionary in Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving Solutions, raised a $20 million Series B funding round—bringing our total funding to $60 million, and earned the trust of top-tier institutions worldwide, who rely on our platform daily to streamline client communications.

This is just the beginning—we're growing rapidly and we're seeking passionate, talented individuals to join our team.

This is your opportunity to work on impactful projects using cutting-edge technologies alongside driven innovators from around the world.

Apply now to be part of something revolutionary!

data.title: Freelance Software Developer (Golang) - AI Trainer
data.text:
At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as an AI Tutor in Coding, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

- Generate prompts that challenge AI
- Define comprehensive scoring criteria to evaluate the accuracy of the AI's answers
- Correct the model's responses based on your domain-specific knowledge

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

- You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or other related fields.
- You have at least 3 years of professional experience with Golang
- Code review experience is a must
- Experience with AI projects is a plus

Benefits

- Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments

data.title: VN Technology Principal Backend Engineer
data.text:
Recruitment Background

CADDi is on a mission to "Unleash the potential of manufacturing."

We operate "CADDi DRAWER," a cloud-based system that supports digital transformation centered on the use of drawings, which are the most essential data in the manufacturing industry.

We are looking for someone who can lead the technology selection and architectural decision-making processes in rapidly expanding services and organizations. The ideal candidate will also be responsible for building backend applications with a strong emphasis on sustainable operability. Additionally, this position requires the ability of developing and formulating technology strategies that align with business goals, while providing technical leadership to the development team in this position.

Expected Role

- Lead technology selection and architecture decisions for a rapidly expanding service and organization
- Build back-end applications with sustainable operational viability in mind
- Planning and formulation of technology strategy aligned with business strategy and technical lead of development organization

Examples of anticipated tasks (not limited to)

- Leading system requirements definition and domain modeling
- Designing architecture of backend systems
- Hand on the design and development of the system, including unit test & documentation
- Implement features & integration with clean, efficient code, following best practices for software development

data.title: VN Technology Principal Backend Engineer
data.text:
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to the continuous improvement of the development process

Interest And Experience Gained From This Position

- The fun of integrating a complex domain into a system
- Experience in solving difficult problems with highly motivated team members
- Experience in contributing to the scale of a product with technical skills
- Experience in developing products that are deployed globally
- Experience in providing value to society through the development of products that change

Requirements

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

For this position, the following are strongly requested.

- 8+ years of hands-on experience developing backend systems for web application
- Experience with technology verification, requirements analysis, architecture design, and infrastructure construction for development teams or multiple projects
- Experience in resolving issues related to technology, product, or development process
- Experience in back-end development and operation of web applications using statically typed languages & framework
- Proficiency in developing within a Docker native infrastructure environment
- Fluent business communication skills in English, ability to complete daily tasks in English, including text communication and meetings.（CEFR B1 or Higher level)
- Must currently reside in Vietnam or have plans to relocate. Foreign nationals must also hold a valid Vietnam work permit or be legally eligible to work in Vietnam

Nice-to-have Requirements

data.text:
- Experience in design and development of large systems across multiple teams
- Experience in development based on domain-driven design
- Experience working with Scrum or Agile methodologies
- Experience developing in languages with strong statically typed and functional elements such as Rust, Scala, etc
- Knowledge of front-end development, libraries & framework such as Reactjs, Next.js is a plus
- Experience designing, developing, and operating microservices
- Experience developing security-conscious web applications
- Business level Japanese proficiency

WE ARE LOOKING FOR THIS KIND OF PERSON

- Those who can sympathize with CADDi's mission "Unleashing the Potential of the Manufacturing Industry"
- Those who have a T-shaped ambition mindset to maximize their expertise by not only focusing on back-end and infrastructure, but also catching up on peripheral knowledge as needed
- Those who are able to face essential issues and take action to solve them with a sense of ownership
- Able to work through positive attitude and constructive discussions in fast-changing and uncertain situations
- Able to communicate and discuss with an attitude of respect for others, taking into consideration their context and resolution

PRODUCT DEVELOPING ENVIRONMENT

- Front-end:TypeScript, React, Next.js
- Backend: Rust(axum),TypeScript, Node.js (Express, Fastify, NestJS)
- Machine Learning/Algorithms: Rust, Python, OpenCV, PyTorch, TorchServe, Elasticsearch, Vertex AI

Our team is responsible for creating a brand of new digital financial platforms and apps that are highly reliable and scalable using modern engineering practices. You will be joining a project which talented software engineers in our Digital Bank Build team who is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the new digital banking platform and the customer channels. As part of the team, you will be responsible for implementing software features, involve in technical designs, and writing tests to ensure the high-quality delivery of the product. The teams operate in Scrum and DevOps models.
We’re looking for top engineers out there! During the interview process, we will test your coding and design skills to assess your experience and depth of knowledge. Don’t worry our interview process will be fun!

• As a backend engineer, you will be working within a specific problem where you will design, develop, and deploy backend services with a focus on scalability, high availability, and low latency.

data.text:
Verticurl, a division of , was established in 2006 with the mission to be the world’s leading marketing technology services agency for multinational organizations. We enable our clients to assess, deploy and integrate MarTech platforms, activate customer experience technologies, implement lead management processes that accelerate revenue conversion and leverage marketing technology to achieve operational excellence. For more information, please visit the website:

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Solution Architect to join our Creative Technology Hub, with a focus on modern web and mobile technologies, enhanced by creative tech and emerging innovations such as AR, VR, Web3, AI, and Machine Learning.

In this role, you will play a pivotal part in designing and delivering innovative, future-ready solutions that leverage these technologies to meet our clients’ evolving needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to define scalable, robust, and flexible architectures.

Your deep expertise in architectural principles, cloud solutions, DevOps practices, and cutting-edge technologies will be instrumental in shaping the technical direction of our projects and providing strong leadership across our development teams.

Evaluation and Optimization: Evaluate existing systems and technologies, identifying areas for improvement and optimization. Provide recommendations for enhancements, architectural changes, or technology adoption to enhance overall solution quality and performance.

- Cơ hội được thử sức trong những lĩnh vực công nghệ tiên tiến, hiện đại nhất.

# Môi trường năng động sáng tạo
- Môi trường làm việc cởi mở và năng động, khuyến khích trao đổi ý tưởng ở mọi cấp, cho phép bạn làm việc, sáng tạo theo cách riêng.
- Được khơi gợi cảm hứng làm việc với văn phòng xanh, không gian mở, hiện đại tiêu chuẩn quốc tế.

# Cơ hội thử thách và phát triển
- Áp dụng kiến thức, kĩ năng, kinh nghiệm chuyên môn giải quyết các bài toán hấp dẫn, thử thách tại Viettel.
- Cơ hội thử sức ở nhiều lĩnh vực, sản phẩm và quốc gia khác nhau góp phần thay đổi xã hội.

data.title: Junior Frontend Developer
data.company: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN ĐẦU TƯ VÀ CÔNG NGHỆ BẦU TRỜI XANH
data.text: Mô tả công việc: Tham gia phát triển nền tảng quản trị giáo dục: Xây dựng và nâng cấp các ứng dụng web, di động (iOS, Android) và/hoặc desktop (Windows, macOS) nhằm cải thiện trải nghiệm học tập và tối ưu hóa quy trình vận hành. Thiết kế và xây dựng giao diện người dùng (UI): Phát triển các tính năng giao diện thân thiện, tuân thủ tiêu chuẩn thiết kế, đảm bảo khả năng bảo trì, mở rộng và tương thích đa nền tảng. Bảo trì và tối ưu hóa hệ thống: Xử lý các lỗi kỹ thuật, cải thiện hiệu suất và đề xuất các giải pháp nâng cao chất lượng sản phẩm. Thu thập và phân tích phản hồi: Làm việc với người dùng và khách hàng để thu thập ý kiến, từ đó đề xuất và triển khai các giải pháp cải tiến nhằm nâng cao trải nghiệm người dùng. Yêu cầu ứng viên: Kỹ thuật: React/React Native: Thành thạo các khái niệm cốt lõi của React (component, state, props, hooks) và/hoặc React Native để phát triển giao diện web hoặc di động. HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript: Nắm vững các công nghệ frontend cơ bản, có khả năng xây dựng giao diện responsive và tối ưu trải nghiệm người dùng. Flutter/Dart: Có kinh nghiệm phát triển ứng dụng di động hoặc desktop với Flutter, bao gồm xây dựng giao diện (Widgets) và quản lý trạng thái (Provider, Riverpod, hoặc Bloc), là một lợi thế lớn. Git: Thành thạo sử dụng Git (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) để quản lý mã nguồn và làm việc nhóm. Kiến thức nền tảng: Hiểu rõ các khái niệm cốt lõi về phát triển web (DOM, event handling) và ứng dụng di động/desktop (vòng đời ứng dụng, quản lý tài nguyên). Phân tích và xử lý lỗi: Có khả năng phân tích, phát hiện và đề xuất giải pháp cho các vấn đề kỹ thuật từ cơ bản đến phức tạp trong các module phần mềm. Kinh nghiệm: Tối thiểu 1 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí Frontend Engineer hoặc tương đương, đã tham gia phát triển ứng dụng thực tế sử dụng React/React Native. Có kinh nghiệm với Flutter (đặc biệt là ứng dụng desktop) là một lợi thế, nhưng không bắt buộc. Có ít nhất 1-2 dự án thực tế (cá nhân, thực tập, hoặc đồ án) thể hiện kỹ năng phát triển frontend, ưu tiên nếu đã publish hoặc có mã nguồn trên GitHub. Ưu tiên: Có kinh nghiệm tích hợp API (REST, GraphQL). Hiểu biết về UI/UX và sử dụng công cụ thiết kế như Figma để phối hợp với đội ngũ thiết kế. Có kinh nghiệm viết unit test hoặc integration test để đảm bảo chất lượng mã nguồn. Có kinh nghiệm với cơ sở dữ liệu (SQL Server, hoặc NoSQL) là một lợi thế. Quyền lợi: Lương từ 20 – 50 triệu/tháng tùy kinh nghiệm và năng lực. Nâng cao kỹ năng chuyên sâu về React/React Native và cơ hội học hỏi Flutter để phát triển ứng dụng đa nền tảng. Phát triển lên các vị trí như Middle/Senior Frontend Developer hoặc chuyển hướng sang vai trò Full-stack Developer. Tham gia các dự án đa dạng.

data.title: Fullstack Web Developer (.NET/VueJS)
data.text:
- O&M (Operation & Maintenance) cho các hệ thống web như DDMS, R+, EOS tại Việt Nam.
- Công nghệ chính: .NET, Vue.js
- Nhiệm vụ: Giám sát hệ thống, xử lý sự cố, tối ưu hiệu suất → đảm bảo hệ thống vận hành ổn định.
- Xây dựng tài liệu O&M và hệ thống tri thức nội bộ.
- Ghi lại quy trình xử lý, hỗ trợ tối ưu hóa tương lai.
- Phát triển API:
- Thiết kế và xây dựng các API chất lượng cao.
- Đảm bảo tính ổn định, bảo mật, dễ sử dụng.
- Phát triển frontend:
- Thành thạo Vue.js và Nuxt.js.
- Tập trung vào trải nghiệm người dùng và giao diện trực quan.
- Quản trị CSDL:
- Làm việc với SQL Server: CRUD cơ bản, backup dữ liệu.
- Cấu hình IIS server trên Windows:
- Biết cách triển khai, cấu hình, khôi phục khi gặp sự cố.
- Kỹ năng phân tích & xử lý sự cố:
- Có khả năng logic tốt, xử lý nhanh các sự cố vận hành.
- Kỹ năng giao tiếp với khách hàng:
- Giao tiếp tốt bằng tiếng anh
- Chủ động lắng nghe phản hồi, đưa yêu cầu từ khách hàng về cho team phát triển nội bộ.

data.title: Devops Engineer
data.company: Công ty cổ phần nghiên cứu phát triển và cung cấp dịch vụ AI Việt Nam
data.text:
1. Xây dựng & duy trì hạ tầng hiện tại
CI/CD Pipeline: Thiết lập và duy trì các pipeline tự động hóa quy trình phát triển phần mềm, bao gồm GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, v.v.
Môi trường triển khai: Quản lý và cấu hình môi trường staging và production, đảm bảo quá trình auto-deploy diễn ra an toàn và hiệu quả.
Cloud Infrastructure: Quản lý và tối ưu hóa hạ tầng trên các nền tảng cloud như AWS, bao gồm việc triển khai, giám sát và tối ưu hóa chi phí
2. Giám sát & phản ứng nhanh với hệ thống
Monitoring & Alerting: Thiết lập hệ thống giám sát với các công cụ như Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry, ELK Stack để theo dõi hiệu suất và phát hiện sớm sự cố.
Incident Response: Phân tích và xử lý sự cố kịp thời, thực hiện root-cause analysis và cải tiến quy trình để giảm thiểu rủi ro trong tương lai.
3. Bảo mật & ổn định
Quản lý Secrets: Sử dụng các công cụ như Vault, AWS Secrets Manager để quản lý và bảo vệ thông tin nhạy cảm.
Access Control: Cấu hình và duy trì các chính sách bảo mật như security groups, tường lửa, Single Sign-On (SSO) để đảm bảo an toàn cho hệ thống.
4. Tối ưu hệ thống
Hiệu suất & Chi phí: Theo dõi và phân tích hiệu suất hệ thống, đề xuất và triển khai các giải pháp tối ưu hóa để cải thiện hiệu suất và giảm thiểu chi phí vận hành.
Scalability: Làm việc chặt chẽ với các nhóm kỹ thuật để thiết kế và triển khai các kiến trúc hạ tầng có thể mở rộng (scale up, scale out) theo nhu cầu phát triển của công ty.
5. Tự độ hoá & Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

Documentation: Viết và duy trì tài liệu chi tiết về hạ tầng, quy trình triển khai và các best practices để đảm bảo tính nhất quán và dễ dàng bảo trì.

Yêu cầu ứng viên
Kinh nghiệm & Kiến thức
Kinh nghiệm: Có từ 2-3 năm kinh nghiệm thực tế trong lĩnh vực DevOps.
CI/CD: Thành thạo trong việc thiết lập và duy trì các pipeline CI/CD, bao gồm việc tích hợp và triển khai tự động.
Cloud Platforms: Kinh nghiệm làm việc với ít nhất 1 trong các nền tảng cloud như AWS, GCP hoặc Azure.

Networking: Kiến thức cơ bản về mạng, bao gồm DNS, VPN, firewall và các giao thức mạng phổ biến.
Kỹ năng bổ sung
IaC: Kinh nghiệm với các công cụ Infrastructure as Code như Terraform hoặc Pulumi.
Monitoring Tools: Kinh nghiệm với các công cụ giám sát như Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry hoặc ELK Stack.
Security: Hiểu biết về các best practices bảo mật trong DevOps, bao gồm việc quản lý secrets, cấu hình quyền truy cập và bảo vệ hệ thống khỏi các mối đe doạ.

data.text: MiTek® is a global provider of building solutions for the residential and commercial construction industries. Utilizing software, services, engineered products, and automated manufacturing equipment, MiTek partners with clients to accelerate their genius and deliver breakthroughs in building. With a rich 60-year history and a network of 6,500 team members worldwide, MiTek pairs local expertise with global capabilities. As a Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE: BRK-A, NYSE: BRK-B) company since 2001, MiTek has a record of continuous growth and innovation. Learn more at www.mii.com. Reporting to the Manager, the Software Engineer must ensure a smooth efficient service that meets the expectations and needs of our customers and continues to grow & develop our staff. data.title: QA Manager (Head of Quality)
data.text:
1. Define and Lead QA Strategy: Develop and implement a comprehensive QA strategy aligned with VNGGames' goals, including test planning, risk management, and quality standards.
2. Drive Process Improvement: Embed quality throughout the development lifecycle by initiating process improvements and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
3. Lead QA Team Execution: Oversee the QA team in planning and executing manual, automated, and exploratory testing efforts.
4. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps teams to ensure clear requirements and shared ownership of quality.
5. Champion Shift-Left Mindset: Promote early testing and quality feedback throughout the development process.
6. Oversee Test Coverage and Reporting: Monitor test coverage, identify gaps, and guide resolution of quality issues.
7. Set Quality Metrics and KPIs: Define and track quality metrics to ensure continuous improvement in platform reliability and performance.
8. Mentor and Grow Team: Coach, train, and develop QA team members to enhance their skills and performance.

data.title: QA Manager (Head of Quality)
data.text:
1. Certification: ISTQB Foundation certification or equivalent knowledge.
2. Experience: At least 5 years of experience in software quality assurance, including 2+ years in a leadership role.
3. Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern QA practices, Agile development, and SDLC.

The new Technical Support Team at the SAP Vietnam/SAP Labs office in Ho Chi Minh City is critical to SAP's future success in the APAC region. We are looking for candidates who strive to make the world run better by delivering exceptional customer support and driving customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do

As a BTP Solution Support Engineer, you will troubleshoot and solve customer issues reported through industry-leading channels within SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). This includes engaging directly with customers, collaborating with development teams, using knowledge repositories, simulating problems, and working on customer systems to resolve complex issues. Your goal is to deliver a high-quality customer experience while developing deep technical expertise.

• Investigate and resolve complex, real-world customer issues related to SAP BTP.
• Provide technical problem-solving and debugging expertise.
• Recommend technical solutions and develop workarounds where needed.
• Properly document communications and actions for customer issues in SAP’s CRM system.
• Use SAP and third-party tools to diagnose issues on customer systems.
• Participate in shift work, including weekends, as scheduled.
• Continuously learn and master SAP software used by industries, governments, and multinational companies.

Technologies Supported
• UX/UI and mobile-based technologies
• SAP FIORI
• Gateway
• Relational databases
• Operating Systems

data.title: Pioneer Talent Program - Smart Contract Security Engineer
data.text:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by over 230 million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

About The Pioneer Talent Program

Are you an early-career professional ready to kickstart your career in the dynamic world of blockchain? Binance’s Pioneer Talent Program is designed to nurture ambitious individuals like you. The program offers full-time roles where participants will gain hands-on expertise via a tailored training curriculum and personalized 1:1 mentorship from industry leaders. Dive behind the scenes of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem while building the skills to thrive in Web3. Launch your career with purpose—join us in shaping the future of digital innovation.

Who May Apply

Candidates with up to 5 years of relevant work experience

About The Role

data.title: Pioneer Talent Program - Smart Contract Security Engineer
data.text:
This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the field and contribute to the blockchain community. You will work hand-in-hand with various talented workers from Binance on the cutting-edge of crypto to guard safety across many projects and systems. You will also coordinate with other teams aside from the security group, which could provide you an in-depth understanding of the crypto world.

Responsibilities

- Conduct security audits and reviews on smart contracts and related protocols. Also write high-quality audit reports
- Develop/Enhance automated scanning and monitoring tools for smart contracts
- Utilize scanning tools to detect vulnerabilities in online contracts and promptly issue risk warnings
- Conduct root cause analysis on various hacking incidents, examining the causes, processes, prevention, correction and basic fund tracing
- Demonstrate a good understanding of EVM chains, and be familiar with DeFi design patterns
- Perform a review analysis on newly disclosed vulnerabilities for smart contracts and summarize the root cause behind the exploits for early detection in the future

Requirements

- Currently enrolled or holding a bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science or a related field
- Proficient in either of the programming languages, such as Solidity, Go among others which are currently engaged with the Blockchain field
- Basic understanding of common Smart Contract security vulnerabilities, Current incidents and Simulation testing

data.title: Pioneer Talent Program - Smart Contract Security Engineer
data.text:
- Basic understanding of blockchain and smart contract principles, experienced with reading Blockchain explorers and creating scripts to track and scan data
- Understanding of different types of solidity libraries and security associated with it
- Familiar with smart contract development testing cycle and transaction analysis

Additional Beneficial Skills

- Passionate about cryptocurrency / DeFi / smart contract / blockchain
- Basic understanding of using VSCode, Git, or other version control applications
- Basic knowledge of detection, exploitation, and prevention of security vulnerabilities
- Experience in smart contracts development (e.g Foundry, HardHat, etc.)
- Have great interest in Binance, high work enthusiasm, fit into remote working culture and responsibility, good and humble work attitude.

Why Binance

- Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
- Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
- Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
- Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
- Competitive salary and company benefits
- Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

Company Introduction

Our mission is to enable every organization to be climate conscious and positive with the world’s best climate software and data products. Persefoni is creating an all-in-one platform that allows organizations to measure, analyze, and reduce their Enterprise Carbon Footprint. Our goal is to provide our customers unprecedented visibility and insights into the impact their organization has on the environment. Leveraging the latest breakthroughs in data science and software, our technology will empower teams and leaders to mobilize their organizations to continuously improve their greenhouse gas emissions metrics.

About The Role (What You Will Get To Do)

As a Senior Software Engineer you will be an integral member of the Software Engineering Department and be partly responsible for building both our product and our web marketing development projects. Successful candidates should have a minimum of five years of recent professional programming experience at positions requiring the skills listed below with an emphasis on React and Typescript. Our project entails implementing our pre-approved development targets and developing a robust and reusable code framework to deliver a variety of new features across our product lines according to our preferred architecture design and best practices.

Responsibilities (What We Expect)
- Plays a key role in setting medium-to-long term strategy for business-impacting projects.

Mục đích của vị trí:

Dẫn dắt và chịu trách nhiệm chính việc ứng dụng các phương pháp phân tích nâng cao, học máy, học sâu và/hoặc GenAI để xây dựng ứng dụng AI/phân tích hệ thống dữ liệu phức tạp, tìm kiếm các hiểu biết sâu sắc về hành vi khách hàng và đưa ra các khuyến nghị chiến lược có giá trị cho đơn vị.
Đóng vai trò cố vấn chuyên môn, hướng dẫn phát triển năng lực kỹ thuật trong nhóm

Nhiệm vụ chính:

- Tham mưu cho Trưởng phòng trong việc xây dựng kế hoạch triển khai các sáng kiến phân tích nâng cao, học máy, học sâu và/hoặc GenAI phù hợp với định hướng chiến lược.
- Chủ động phối hợp với các đơn vị kinh doanh, hỗ trợ kinh doanh và các phòng/ban liên quan trong nội bộ Khối EDA để xác định bài toán, thống nhất yêu cầu, thiết kế giải pháp và phương án triển khai.

- Thiết kế và giám sát triển khai các sản phẩm dữ liệu hoặc mô hình AI/ML/GenAI có khả năng tái sử dụng và mở rộng quy mô, đóng vai trò then chốt trong các sáng kiến quan trọng nhắm thúc đẩy kinh doanh, tối ưu hóa kênh tiếp cận, tự động hóa vận hành, ra quyết định thông minh và cá nhân hóa hành trình khách hàng.
- Tư vấn kỹ thuật cho các phòng ban nghiệp vụ, giúp định hình bài toán kinh doanh thành các giải pháp phân tích cụ thể và khả thi; đồng thời đảm bảo việc lựa chọn thuật toán, kiến trúc mô hình, pipeline dữ liệu và các công nghệ nền tảng là phù hợp và tối ưu.
- Thực hiện hoặc giám sát phân tích khám phá dữ liệu chuyên sâu và khai thác insight chiến lược, giúp Ban điều hành, các khối kinh doanh/vận hành thấu hiểu khách hàng, xác định cơ hội tăng trưởng, hoặc phát hiện rủi ro tiềm ẩn.
- Tham gia đánh giá và giám sát chất lượng toàn bộ vòng đời mô hình, bao gồm việc thiết kế hệ thống giám sát mô hình (model monitoring), đánh giá drift, lên kế hoạch re-training và kiểm soát rủi ro mô hình (model risk).
- Đóng vai trò cố vấn chuyên môn (technical mentor) cho các chuyên viên trong nhóm/phòng/bộ phận khác, hỗ trợ phát triển năng lực nội bộ, lan tỏa thực hành tốt và xây dựng năng lực AI/ML/GenAI bền vững cho tổ chức.

data.title: QA Automation Engineer (all genders)
data.text:
Hrs As a Company

HRS, a pioneer in business travel, aims to elevate every stay through innovative technology. With over 50 years of experience, their digital platform, driven by ProcureTech, TravelTech, and FinTech, transforms how companies and travelers Stay, Work, and Pay.

ProcureTech digitally revolutionizes lodging procurement, connecting corporations and suppliers in a cutting-edge ecosystem. This enables seamless efficiency and automation, surpassing travelers' expectations.

TravelTech redefines the online lodging experience, offering personalized content from selection to check-in, ensuring an unparalleled journey for corporate travelers.

In FinTech, HRS introduces advancements like mobile banking and digital payments, turning corporate back offices into touchless lodging enablers, eliminating legacy cost barriers. The innovative 2-click book-to-pay feature streamlines interactions for travelers and hoteliers.

Combining these technology propositions, HRS unlocks exponential catalyst effects. Their data-driven focus delivers value-added services and high-return network effects, creating substantial customer value.

HRS's exponential growth since 1972 serves over 35% of the global Fortune 500 and leading hotel chains.

Join HRS to shape the future of business travel, empowered by a culture of growth and setting new industry standards worldwide.

BUSINESS UNIT

BUSINESS TRAVEL CLUB

data.title: QA Automation Engineer (all genders)
data.text:
The HRS Business Travel Club (BTC) is the Business Unit managing and developing the HRS E-Commerce platforms of the well-known hotel portal businesses of HRS.de and HOTEL.DE that gradually transform into much more than “just” a platform. BTC provides its members, individual business travelers and SMEs, with a distinct range of exclusive services, which shape tomorrow´s upgraded travel experience. The goal of BTC is to deliver growth as well as sustainable profitability over time by enhancing customer loyalty between the brand and its customers, enabling the Brands Repositioning in the marketplace and unlocking additional potentials via optimized supplier management. Thus, BTC and its products, plays an important role in HRS´s DACH strategy as it revolves around a disruption of the interplay between hotel and workplace supply and e-commerce and a domination of the Business Travel DACH market. Your mission is to further develop and shape the "The HRS Business Travel Club" and its solutions and make it the next innovation of the HRS Group together with a great team.

POSITION

data.title: QA Automation Engineer (all genders)
data.text:
As a QA Engineer, you will work closely with our Product and Development teams to design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases that ensure our digital products meet our high standards of quality. You will be responsible for both manual and automated testing processes, leveraging modern frameworks and monitoring tools. Your expertise will contribute to the continuous improvement of our solutions that support a dynamic, personalized travel experience and contribute to the company's vision of becoming the mobile travel companion for business travelers.

CHALLENGE

Together With Your Team, You Will Take The Customer View First And Raise The Bar In Delivering Business Travel Solutions By

- Develop and implement detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases for both manual and automated testing
- Design and implement automation test frameworks and scripts for web applications built with NextJS
- Perform manual testing of mobile applications (Flutter) and responsive web applications across different devices and screen sizes
- Identify, record, document thoroughly, and track bugs through to resolution
- Perform thorough regression testing when bugs are resolved
- Monitor application performance and analyze logs using New Relic
- Liaise with internal teams (e.g., developers and product managers) to identify system requirements and ensure the quality of the product
- Stay up-to-date with new testing and monitoring tools

data.title: QA Manager - Exp in Back Office/Human Resource projects
data.text:
About us
At Money Forward Vietnam (MFV), we are actively engaged in the forefront of financial technology. Our portfolio, encompassing over 50 services across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C sectors, aims to mitigate financial challenges for a broad audience. A critical aspect of our strategy is developing our engineering team within a global framework. As part of the Money Forward Group, transitioning swiftly into a global tech leader, MFV is strategically positioned to enhance our engineering capabilities through focused investment.
We are advancing a major project in enterprise-level HR solutions, collaboratively developed by our teams in Vietnam and Japan, targeted initially at Japanese companies with future plans for global expansion. To push this project forward, we are looking for a capable leader to oversee our diverse engineering team, including Backend, Frontend, QA, and Product Owner. This role involves close collaboration with our Japanese team and driving the product toward sustained success over the next three years and beyond. This position offers visibility to senior management in Vietnam and Japan and represents a significant opportunity for career development as a senior manager in QA.

Lead a Team: Direct a project team of 10+ members, managing all aspects of product development and fostering team cohesion.
